description: Turn a script into a talking-head video the user films on their phone. Pass `script` to have them say your exact words (nothing is rewritten — it is only cut into takes), or `topic` to have oriiion write the script. Returns a link that opens a teleprompter + camera on a phone, and shows a QR code to scan when opened on a computer — so it works whichever device this chat is on. The user films each take, then the video renders automatically (1-3 min) and appears ON THAT SAME PAGE, where they can edit the caption, subtitle style, hook and CTA and re-render. This chat cannot be notified when the render finishes — always tell the user the video arrives on that page, and use get_video_shoot_status when they come back and ask.

folderPath.description: File the shoot under a client/project folder, levels separated by '/' — e.g. 'Filmstaden/Spiderman'. Folders are created if they don't exist. Call list_shoot_folders first to reuse an existing one.

productIds.description: Products the video is about (list_products ids). Their catalogue facts go into the script and at least one take shows each product on camera.

script.description: The exact words to say on camera. Filmed verbatim — use this when the user wants their own wording.

sourceShootId.description: Re-record the original script and take order without rewriting. Omit script/topic.

targetSeconds.description: How long the finished video should run, in seconds. Only used when writing from a topic.

topic.description: What the video should be about, if oriiion should write the script instead.
